# The process dies while a command step of a round item runs. Someone removes the worktree and the base moves while no run is alive.
# The next run resumes the item and makes the worktree again at the commit that the run started on, not at the new tip of the base.
isolate

exec git init -q -b main origin
exec git -C origin add readme.txt
exec git -C origin -c user.name=e2e -c user.email=e2e@example.com commit -q -m start
exec git -C origin checkout -q -b integration/r1
exec git -C origin add BASE_MARKER
exec git -C origin -c user.name=e2e -c user.email=e2e@example.com commit -q -m base
exec git -C origin checkout -q main

fixture project.star config/projects/local.star
replace config/projects/local.star '~/work/your-repo' $WORK/origin
subst flow/round.star

exec beehavereal item add local round/integration/r1 --title 'The round' --body-file body.txt
! exec beehavereal run round/integration/r1 local --workflow flow/round.star &
waitfile started
kill -KILL
wait

rm state/trees/local/round_2Fintegration_2Fr1
exec git -C origin checkout -q integration/r1
exec git -C origin add MOVED_MARKER
exec git -C origin -c user.name=e2e -c user.email=e2e@example.com commit -q -m moved
exec git -C origin checkout -q main
exec git -C origin rev-parse integration/r1
cp stdout new-tip
cp body.txt second

exec beehavereal run round/integration/r1 local --workflow flow/round.star
stdout 'item round/integration/r1 finished'

# The step ran again at the start commit of the run, detached, and the tree holds no commit of the moved base.
cmp second.head first.head
! cmp second.head new-tip
grep '^detached$' second.mode
grep '^absent$' second.moved

-- body.txt --
The round of the base.
-- origin/readme.txt --
The source repository.
-- origin/BASE_MARKER --
base marker
-- origin/MOVED_MARKER --
moved
-- flow/round.star --
def main(item):
    command(name = "work", run = ["sh", "-c", "if [ -e @WORK@/second ]; then git rev-parse HEAD > @WORK@/second.head; git symbolic-ref -q HEAD > /dev/null && echo branch > @WORK@/second.mode || echo detached > @WORK@/second.mode; test -e MOVED_MARKER && echo present > @WORK@/second.moved || echo absent > @WORK@/second.moved; else git rev-parse HEAD > @WORK@/first.head; echo x > @WORK@/started; sleep 20; fi"])
